name: sanpaid-yukti-2026

scripts.build: node scripts/build.mjs && mkdir -p dist/assets && cp reference-hero-v3.css dist/reference-hero-v3.css && cp mobile-nav-right-fix.css dist/mobile-nav-right-fix.css && cp reference-hero-v3.js dist/reference-hero-v3.js && cp dashboard-shell-lock.js dist/dashboard-shell-lock.js && cat build-assets/hero-final-*.b64 | tr -d '\n' | base64 -d > dist/assets/sanpaid-reference-hero-right.webp && echo '17abdde5a97579324679e2d9bb81cfae2a0da180  dist/assets/sanpaid-reference-hero-right.webp' | sha1sum -c - && sed -i 's#</head>#<link rel="preload" as="image" href="/assets/sanpaid-reference-hero-right.webp"><link rel="stylesheet" href="/reference-hero-v3.css"><link rel="stylesheet" href="/mobile-nav-right-fix.css"><script defer src="/reference-hero-v3.js"></script><script defer src="/dashboard-shell-lock.js"></script></head>#' dist/index.html
scripts.test: node tests/runtime-integrity.mjs && node --test tests/backend-policy.test.mjs tests/matching-policy.test.mjs tests/public-proof-truth.test.mjs tests/judge-truth.test.mjs tests/worker-truth.test.mjs tests/complaints-sla.test.mjs tests/billing-policy.test.mjs tests/auth-security.test.mjs tests/capacity-governance.test.mjs tests/ui-contract.test.mjs
